about.description: Fixed expressions in which a capital letter after a word is a letter, not a Roman numeral. tugaphone.text_normalization.expand_regnal_numerals leaves the letter as written when the word right before it matches an entry.
about.match: Each entry is '<word> <letter>'. The word is compared case-insensitively with the word before the letter, with its trailing punctuation removed. The letter is compared exactly.
about.guards: The entries with a letter that is not I, V or X (vitamina C, complexo B, Dia D, Plano B) do not convert under the current rules. They are kept so that a later rule cannot read them as numerals.

expressions.raio X: radiation, the equipment and the exam (Priberam DLPO, 'raio X')
expressions.raios X: plural; synonym of 'raios de Röntgen' (Priberam DLPO, 'raio')
expressions.projeto X: placeholder project name; a film title
expressions.Malcolm X: the name of Malcolm X; Malcolm is a given name
expressions.Twitter X: the service named Twitter/X, written with a space
